turns.reply:
I'm sorry your stove got lost in transit — that's frustrating. I've refunded the full **$46.99** (the total you paid, including shipping) to your original payment method; this went through right away.

Note I can only refund what was actually charged, so the extra over $75 isn't something I can issue. Thanks for your patience.
